# Qt 6.8 (QtCore + QtGui + QtWidgets), vendored — `apps/hello-qt-gui`'s and `apps/hello-qt-widgets`'s dependency

Real, largely unmodified Qt 6.8 source — not a reimplementation — plus the
real third-party libraries it bundles, vendored so
[`apps/hello-qt-gui`](../../apps/hello-qt-gui) and
[`apps/hello-qt-widgets`](../../apps/hello-qt-widgets) build offline with a
plain `make`. It is the **full** QtCore + QtGui closure (`QGuiApplication`,
`QWindow`/`QRasterWindow`, `QPainter`, `QImage`, `QFont`, the event loop,
`QThread`, `QRegularExpression`, ...) plus **QtWidgets** (`QApplication`,
`QWidget`, the Fusion and Windows styles, buttons, sliders, tabs, combo boxes,
line/spin edits, layouts, and the item views a combo popup needs), unlike the earlier
[`third_party/qt6`](../qt6) tree which is the small `QT_BOOTSTRAPPED` subset
behind `apps/hello-qt` and is left untouched.

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `qtbase/` | **Real Qt/third-party files**, in their upstream paths (`qtbase/src/corelib/...`, `src/gui/...`, `src/widgets/...`, `src/plugins/platforms/minimal/`, `src/3rdparty/{freetype,harfbuzz-ng,pcre2,double-conversion,siphash,tinycbor}`, `mkspecs/common/posix`). 1,900 files, copied verbatim from `qtbase` branch `6.8` except the 12 patched ones below. Only files the compiler actually reads are here — the set is derived, not guessed (`tools/vendor.py`). |
| `koppios/include/` | What `syncqt` + CMake would generate: the flattened `QtCore/`, `QtGui/`, `QtWidgets/`, `qpa/` include trees (relative symlinks into `qtbase/`, plus the CamelCase forwarding headers) and the per-module config headers (`qconfig.h`, `qtcore-config*.h`, `qtgui-config*.h`, `qtwidgets-config*.h`, export headers, `qconfig.cpp`). The config headers started as the ones a real 6.10 desktop build produces and were edited to this port's feature set (see below). |
| `koppios/mocgen/` | Output of the real `moc` 6.8.4 (built from `qtbase/src/tools/moc`) for every `Q_OBJECT`/`Q_GADGET` header in the closure. Checked in so the build needs no `moc`. Paths inside are `../../qtbase/...`, which is why `mocgen/` and `qtbase/` sit at this depth. |
| `koppios/*.cpp`, `koppios/freetype/`, `koppios/dc_patched/` | **Not Qt source** — the koppios glue (see below). |
| `koppios/sources.mk`, `koppios/incs.mk` | Generated by `tools/vendor.py`: the translation-unit lists (core+gui, widgets, ...) and the ordered `-I` list the Makefiles consume. |
| `koppios/qt.mk` | The shared build rules. An app's Makefile is three lines: `include qt.mk`, then `$(eval $(call QT_APP,<binary>,<source.cpp>,gui\|widgets))`. The object archives are built once into `build/` and shared by every Qt app. |
| `koppios/qt_app.lds` | The linker script every Qt app uses (image at 8 MiB; merges the per-function sections). |
| `LICENSES/` | SPDX texts for everything vendored. |
| `tools/` | How this tree was produced and how to refresh it. |

## The patched Qt files

Every change is marked inline (`grep -r "koppios addition" qtbase`):

| File | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `src/corelib/global/qsystemdetection.h` | `Q_OS_KOPPIOS` is checked **first** and falls through to generic `Q_OS_UNIX` | The host `g++` predefines `__linux__`; without this Qt picks `Q_OS_LINUX` paths (epoll, `/proc`, and an inline `QThread::currentThreadId()` that reads `%gs:8`). |
| 7 × `thread_local` (`qlogging.cpp`, `qloggingregistry.cpp`, `qobject.cpp`, `qproperty.cpp`, `qregularexpression.cpp`, `qthread_unix.cpp`, `qtimezoneprivate_tz.cpp`) | `thread_local` removed (plain `static`) | This kernel sets up no `%gs` TLS segment and GCC 15 has no `-femulated-tls`; native `thread_local` page-faults at address ~0. Single-threaded closure only. |
| `src/widgets/kernel/qwidget.cpp` | `QWidgetPrivate::flagsForDumping()` builds its geometry string with `QByteArray` (`tools/patch_widgets.py`) | The original uses `std::stringstream`; there are no libstdc++ iostreams here. |
| `src/gui/kernel/qguiapplication.cpp` | `init_platform()` calls `qt_koppios_create_platform_integration()` | There is no `dlopen()` plugin loader. |
| `src/plugins/platforms/minimal/qminimalintegration.cpp` | `fontDatabase()` returns `qt_koppios_create_font_database()` | Qt's own minimal platform plugin has no usable font database without fontconfig. |
| `src/corelib/thread/qthreadpool.cpp` | `QThreadPoolPrivate::qtGuiInstance()` always returns null (Qt's own `QT_NO_GUI_THREADPOOL` path) | Qt parallelizes big image fills/conversions through it. A worker thread's stack is placed at a fixed offset above the image, which collides with a heap that has grown in place, and thread exit then unmaps live heap pages (a kernel layout bug, see below). Image code falls back to its serial path. |

`koppios/dc_patched/string-to-double.cc` is a patched **copy** of the upstream
file (`std::locale::classic()`'s `ctype<char>::tolower` is plain ASCII
`tolower`; libstdc++'s locale machinery is not available here).

## The koppios glue (`koppios/`)

* `qt_koppios_platform.cpp` — subclasses Qt's own `QMinimalIntegration`:
  * **windows** get an expose event and keyboard focus when shown;
  * a tiny **compositor**: every visible top-level window (the main window,
    combo-box popups, ...) is drawn at its geometry into one screen-sized
    `QImage` (640×400, `KOPPIOS_SCREEN_WIDTH/HEIGHT`, which the patched
    `qminimalintegration.cpp` uses for the `QScreen` too), a pointer arrow is
    overlaid, and the result is quantized (adaptive palette: 16 reserved greys
    plus a 240-colour median cut of the first frame, RGB555 lookup table,
    luminance-only 4×4 Bayer dither, so smooth gradients do not band or tint)
    and presented with `gfx_open`/`gfx_palette`/`gfx_blit` (syscalls 22–25, the
    full-screen-grab path `apps/doom` uses);
  * **input**: a poll timer turns the raw scancode ring (syscall 26) into
    `QKeyEvent`s and the raw pointer ring (syscall 36, `getmouse`) into mouse
    press/release/move events, so the keyboard and the mouse both drive the
    widgets (Tab focus chain, arrows, Space, typing, clicks, drags);
  * a **platform theme** that names `Fusion` as the default widget style
    (Qt's minimal plugin would otherwise fall back to `Windows`).
* `qkoppiosfontdatabase.cpp` — a `QFreeTypeFontDatabase` that registers
  `/rd/font.ttf`.
* `qshader_koppios.cpp` — six `QShader` members the RHI references; real
  `qshader.cpp` needs zlib.
* `qresources_koppios.cpp` — empty `qInitResources_*` stubs for the resource
  bundles (`.qrc` icons, translations) that were not compiled in.
* `qstandardpaths_koppios.cpp` — no per-user directories exist.
* `freetype/` — FreeType's module list trimmed to TrueType + smooth/mono
  rasterizers + `psnames` + autofit; memory-only `ftsystem`; gzip stubs.
* `../../lib/qfileengine_koppios.cpp`, `../../lib/qfsfileengine_koppios_stub.cpp`
  — Qt's `QAbstractFileEngineHandler` over the kernel's file syscalls (these
  live in `lib/`, built by the app's Makefile with the Qt flags).

## Configuration decisions (all forced by a real failure)

* **QtWidgets** is trimmed by hand-editing `qtwidgets-config.h` /
  `qtwidgets-config_p.h` (copied from a 6.10 SDK): the main-window/dock/toolbar
  machinery, text editors, `QTreeView`/`QTableView` and the calendar are off
  (`tools/exclude_widgets.txt` lists the `.cpp` files that go with them), and
  `src/widgets/dialogs` and `src/widgets/graphicsview` are not vendored at all. Four things stay **on** because Qt 6.8 cannot be built without
  them: `style_stylesheet` + `style_windows` (`QWidget` includes
  `QStyleSheetStyle` unconditionally) and `menu` (`QCommonStyle` compiles its
  menu-item sizing and drawing only under `QT_CONFIG(menu)`; with it off every
  combo-box popup row is as big as the whole list view).
  The core `shortcut` feature (`QKeySequence`, `QShortcutMap`, `QShortcut`) is
  also **on**, and must be: upstream binds Esc-closes-a-combo-popup, the
  line edit's cursor/Backspace/Delete/Home/End/Ctrl+A/copy-paste and a button's
  cancel to `QKeySequence::StandardKey` matches, all compiled out otherwise.
  The legacy `QT_NO_*` macros in `qt.mk` must again agree with these flags —
  a mismatch changes class layouts between translation units, so changing a
  feature means rebuilding the whole module.
* `QT_STATIC`, `QT_NO_COMPRESS`; `zstd`, `icu`, `glib`, `inotify`, `renameat2`,
  `forkfd_pidfd` off in QtCore; `evdev`, `kms`, `xkbcommon`, `wayland`, `xcb`,
  `fontconfig`, `vnc`, ... off in QtGui. Legacy `QT_NO_<FEATURE>` macros must
  agree with the `QT_FEATURE_*` flags (see the `Makefile`).
* **No** `-fkeep-inline-functions`: it made object files ~50× larger and got
  `ar`/`ld` OOM-killed.
* `-DQT_QPA_DEFAULT_PLATFORM_NAME='"minimal"'`.
* Some `.cpp` files in Qt are `#include`d by another `.cpp` and must not be
  compiled alone (`qchar.cpp`, `qstringmatcher.cpp`, `qcssscanner.cpp`, ...);
  the derived source list excludes them.
* The app must pass an **absolute** `argv[0]` (`/rd/hqtgui`): there is no
  `PATH` search, and `QLibraryInfo` asserts if `applicationDirPath()` is empty.

## What the kernel/libc had to grow for this

Real fixes in `lib/` that every user-space app can use: glibc-shaped `ctype`
tables, a real `getcwd`, `setlocale`/`nl_langinfo` for `C.UTF-8`, an
in-process `eventfd` + working `ppoll`/`poll` (so Qt's *real* Unix event
dispatcher runs), a millisecond `clock_gettime`, `wcscoll`/`strcoll`,
`strtok_r`, x87-backed `atan`/`exp`/`exp2`/`log`/`log2`/`log10`, and VFS-aware
absolute paths in the Qt file engine.

Kernel additions for the widgets work: syscall **36** `getmouse` (a raw
pointer-event ring fed by the PS/2 and USB HID mouse drivers, one consumer like
the key ring) and syscall **37** `getrandom` (≤ 256 bytes from the kernel's
CSPRNG, user pointer range-checked) with a libc `getentropy` on top of it —
`QRandomGenerator` aborts at start-up without one, and `QApplication` seeds
from it.

## Known limitations

* No OpenGL/Vulkan/RHI backend, no accessibility, no drag-and-drop, no
  clipboard, no image-format plugins (PNG/JPEG), no dynamic plugins.
* Compressed `.qrc` resources and `.qsb` shaders are unsupported (no zlib).
* Input is polled (raw scancode + raw pointer rings, every 8 ms): no key repeat
  from the hardware (only what the keyboard driver delivers), no wheel, no
  IME, no touch. Only one top-level application window plus its popups (no
  window manager: no title bars, no moving or resizing).
* QtWidgets: no menu bars, tool bars, dock/main windows, tree/table views,
  text editors, dialogs (`QDialog`, `QMessageBox`, file dialogs), graphics view
  or tool tips (see `tools/exclude_widgets.txt`), and no translation or icon
  resources. Fusion and Windows are the only styles.
* Output is the kernel's 8-bit indexed `gfx_blit`, so colour is limited to one
  256-entry palette per frame sequence (built from the first frame).
* Kernel bug found along the way and **not** fixed here: a secondary thread's
  stack/heap are placed at fixed offsets above the image, so a thread created
  after the main heap has grown past that point overlaps it (thread exit then
  unmaps live heap pages). This port therefore avoids creating GUI worker threads (see the
  `qthreadpool.cpp` patch above); revert that patch once the kernel is fixed.
